name: Light Salmon
lede: Light salmon is a web color, a soft pinkish orange from the X11 set named as a lighter salmon.

sections.title: What the name means
sections.body:
Paterson lists *LightSalmon* as one of the colors in the X11 Color Set, with the hex code #FFA07A [1]. It is a web color first, named as a lighter version of [[salmon]] [1]. The nearest ISCC-NBS name for the swatch is strong yellowish pink [2]. Neighbors are [[light-coral]], [[coral]] and [[peach]] [2]. Like every web color it is defined by a hex code, so the swatch is a screen approximation and not a dye or a paint [2]. Nothing in our books ties it to a pigment or a historical source [1].

The books give no history for the name beyond the color list, so none is claimed [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: In our archive of 23,781 paintings, a color near this swatch appears in 18, 0.08 per cent, rarer than 65 per cent of named colors, as photographed [3]. Inside a painting it is most often an accent, as in 62 per cent of 13 paintings [3]. In Google Books the word peaks in the 1920s [4].
